import json,subprocess,sys,os,base64,zlib
# the folded drafts' own repro and check commands, compressed (their item files are in git history)
R=json.loads(zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode('')))
bad=[]
env=dict(os.environ,NO_COLOR='1')
for i,a in R:
    p=subprocess.run(a,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=600,env=env)
    print(i,'exit',p.returncode)
    if p.returncode: bad.append(i)
print('still failing:',bad);sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)
